name: Ransomware Takes Down Dispatch CAD
description: Ransomware encrypts the regional CAD serving 911 dispatch for police, fire, and EMS; dispatchers fall back to cards and radio for days.
assumptions: Call-taking continues; manual dispatch runs at reduced tempo with mutual-aid backup.
Primary loss covers restoration, overtime across member agencies, and vendor response.
Secondary loss covers liability exposure where response delays are alleged in claims.

name: Telephony Denial of Service on 911 Trunks
description: Automated call floods jam 911 trunks, delaying legitimate emergency calls until carriers filter the traffic.
assumptions: Carrier-level filtering ends most events within hours; overflow routing absorbs some calls.
Primary loss covers response, carrier coordination, and after-action work.
Secondary loss covers claims tied to delayed call answering during the flood.

name: Radio and Paging System Compromise
description: An intruder reaches the trunked radio controller and paging systems, risking jammed talkgroups and false dispatches across responder agencies.
assumptions: Conventional fallback channels are drilled; the loss is degraded coordination, not silence.
Primary loss covers system re-keying, vendor forensics, and interim operations.
Secondary loss covers responder-safety claims and member-agency cost recovery.

name: 911 Call Data Breach
description: An intrusion exposes 911 call recordings, locations, and CAD narratives — including medical details and domestic-violence addresses.
assumptions: Protected-address and medical content triggers duties beyond standard PII notification.
Primary loss covers forensics, notification, and victim-protection coordination.
Secondary loss covers civil liability for endangered callers and HIPAA-adjacent exposure.

name: CAD Cloud Vendor Breach Outage
description: A breach at the hosted CAD vendor forces a precautionary multi-day platform shutdown across all its customer dispatch centers, including this one.
assumptions: The center cannot prevent the vendor event; vulnerability reflects dependence without a warm alternative.
Primary loss covers manual operations and recovery coordination for the outage duration.
Secondary loss covers contract remedies pursued against vendor caps and exclusions.
